2025-06-01
The claimant reported a low-speed collision while backing out of a space in a parking lot and stated that a left
shoulder injury occurred at the time. The claim was opened and the claimant confirmed representation by counsel,
with all further contact to go through the attorney's office.
2025-07-10
Verified that the driver is naemd on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. No
isuses with the policy were found.
2025-07-24
The police report and the statements of the responding officers confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene.
Photos from the scene were requested and received.
2025-08-31
Reviewed the scene photographs, which confirm some of the details described in the claimant's account. No
independent witnesses have been identified to date.
2025-10-20
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage is mostly in line with the impact described by the claimant. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or records.
2025-11-18
Medical records show the reported shoulder injury fits the kind and force of the crash. No prior injury or treatment to
the same body area is known from available records.
2025-11-28
Counsel's demand package received and reviewed. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the
claimant improved, consistent with the records provided.
2025-12-21
The claimant ltaer provided additional small details about the sequence of events, but the core account has remained
the same across all statements taken to date.
2025-12-27
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the policy coverage began. Dates of loss and policy
inception were cross-checked and align.
2026-01-04
File reviewed with the claim supervisor. The claim remains open pending final medical updates from the treating
provider and any further correspondence from counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
